headlines.title: Wall Street Analysts Think American Tower (AMT) Could Surge 27.3%: Read This Before Placing a Bet
headlines.summary: The average of price targets set by Wall Street analysts indicates a potential upside of 27.3% in American Tower (AMT). While the effectiveness of this highly sought-after metric is questionable, the positive trend in earnings estimate revisions might translate into an upside in the stock.

headlines.title: American Tower or Crown Castle? Wall Street’s Clear Pick Between Beaten-Down Tower REITs
headlines.summary: Both cell-tower REITs are trading near one-year lows, and both look cheap on the surface, but one hides a yield trap that could quietly drain a retirement portfolio while the other just raised guidance for the second time this year.

headlines.title: How Record CoreSite Leasing And Strong Q2 Results At American Tower (AMT) Have Changed Its Investment Story
headlines.summary: American Tower Corporation recently reported its second-quarter 2026 results, with revenue rising to US$2,749.1 million and net income reaching US$867.5 million, alongside higher earnings per share versus a year earlier. The company also raised its full-year 2026 outlook, highlighting record leasing at its CoreSite data center business and stronger global tower activity as key earnings drivers.

headlines.title: American Tower Raises Outlook as CoreSite Leasing Reaches Record
headlines.summary: American Tower increased its annual forecasts after stronger data-center performance and favorable currency movements.

headlines.title: American Tower Q2 AFFO Meets Estimates, Revenues Beat, '26 View Up
headlines.summary: AMT's Q2 AFFO comes in line with estimates as revenues top expectations, fueled by tower leasing and data center growth. A higher 2026 outlook signals momentum.

description: American Tower Corporation one of the largest global REITs, is a leading independent owner, operator and developer of multitenant communications real estate with a portfolio of over 148,000 communications sites and a highly interconnected footprint of U.S. data center facilities. American Tower Corporation was incorporated in 1995 in Delaware and is based in Massachusetts, Boston.
